description: Upload an audio file for AI podcast editing. Handles getting a presigned S3 URL and uploading the file. Returns order_id and s3_key needed for submission. Maximum file size: 750MB.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the audio file (supported: mp3, wav, m4a, flac, aac, ogg, aiff)

filename.description: Optional display name for the file. Defaults to original filename.

name: barevalue_upload
